description: This file defines the ShuffleBlockPusher class responsible for pushing shuffle blocks to remote shuffle services in Apache Spark. It includes methods for initiating block pushes, handling push requests, managing push state, and coordinating push completion notifications.

classes.name: ShuffleBlockPusher
classes.description: Handles pushing shuffle blocks to remote shuffle services, managing push requests, state, and completion notifications.

methods.name: createErrorHandler
methods.description: Creates a custom error handler for push failures, determining whether errors should be retried.

methods.name: isPushCompletionNotified
methods.description: Checks if push completion has been notified.

methods.name: initiateBlockPush
methods.description: Starts the process of pushing shuffle blocks based on shuffle dependency and data file.

methods.name: tryPushUpToMax
methods.description: Attempts to push blocks up to the maximum allowed, handling exceptions.

methods.name: submitTask
methods.description: Submits a Runnable task to the push thread pool if available.

methods.name: pushUpToMax
methods.description: Pushes blocks while respecting flow control constraints, synchronized for thread safety.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a push request to a remote shuffle server, handling push result callbacks.

methods.name: sliceReqBufferIntoBlockBuffers
methods.description: Slices a ManagedBuffer into smaller buffers representing individual blocks.

methods.name: updateStateAndCheckIfPushMore
methods.description: Updates push state after a push attempt and determines if more blocks should be pushed.

methods.name: notifyDriverAboutPushCompletion
methods.description: Notifies the driver that all current map task blocks have been pushed.

methods.name: prepareBlockPushRequests
methods.description: Prepares a list of PushRequest objects by grouping shuffle blocks for efficient pushing.

methods.name: createRequestBuffer
methods.description: Creates a ManagedBuffer for a segment of the shuffle data file.
